_note: The three slice blasters (GAME-09), keyed by id, in level order. Units: metres, seconds, degrees. Common fields, then one block for the fire mode: pump (primeTime), auto (fireInterval, spinUp, spinDown, recoil), break (fireInterval). A mod's fields override the blaster's; nested blocks (recoil) merge key by key. Starting values from the blaster cards, marked to tune on the range. Viewmodel placement numbers are first guesses; the reviewer sets them.

chunk._note: GAME-09b: the slug is one heavy dart, so it reaches further than the Leviathan's close blast, with a smaller hole.

bounce._note: Every 5th shot bounces to another target: GAME-09b. Data only for now.

chunk._note: GAME-09b: eight darts at once, close in. rangeMetres from the muzzle to the hit. carveRadius is the hole's radius in metres, the biggest carve in the game. push multiplies the ragdoll's kill push.

B02._note: GAME-09c: the model is the B01 .glb as a placeholder (its first muzzle); the B02 model replaces it when ART-01 ships, no code change. Smaller viewmodel so it reads as a sidearm over the B01 body.
B02.name: Musketeer

burst._note: GAME-09c: mod 1. One press fires three darts, burstGap apart, then the cooldown.

heavy._note: GAME-09c: mod 2, heavy rounds: slugs, slower firing, their own chunk: a bigger carve and push than the standard dart, smaller than B01's slug. rangeMetres runs from the muzzle to the hit.
